## The Devil's Vault (private store)
- Devilishly Heavenly collection, sold only through EvilJay: no Shopify and no card checkout. Buyers pick items, colour and size, then send the direct order form (https://www.eviljaythedevilshow.com/#order) or text (612) 457-5417. EvilJay confirms availability, payment and delivery or Las Vegas pickup personally.
- Devilishly Heavenly Tee: $5,000, cream (red and black devil-and-angel print) or black (white print), sizes S to 3XL.
- Devilishly Heavenly Hat (exclusive): $1,500, cream or black, one size, adjustable.
- The Full Set (tee + hat): $6,500, cream or black.
